name: physics_concepts
description: Name a physics concept from a qualitative definition, without arithmetic or units conversion, versus copying the supplied term.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pairs=[('a push or pull that can change motion','force'),('the capacity to do work','energy'),('the rate at which work is done','power'),('the force attracting masses toward each other','gravity'),('resistance to changes in motion','inertia'),('mass multiplied by velocity','momentum'),('the rate of change of position with direction','velocity'),('the rate of change of velocity','acceleration'),('the force opposing sliding motion','friction'),('energy transferred because of a temperature difference','heat'),('the particle of electromagnetic radiation','photon'),('the negatively charged particle in an atom','electron'),('the positively charged particle in an atomic nucleus','proton'),('the electrically neutral particle in an atomic nucleus','neutron'),('the number of wave cycles per unit time','frequency'),('the distance between successive wave crests','wavelength'),('the bending of light when entering a different medium','refraction'),('the bouncing of light off a surface','reflection'),('the spreading of waves around obstacles','diffraction'),('the upward force exerted by a fluid','buoyancy')]
items=[];control=[]
for r in range(4):
 for desc,term in pairs:
  p=[f'Physics glossary. Definition: {desc}. Term:',f'The physics concept described as {desc} is',f'Name the physics term for {desc}. Answer:',f'In physics, {desc} is called'][r]
  items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+term});control.append({'prompt':f'Copy the physics term. Definition: {desc}. Term: {term}. Copied term:','answer':' '+term})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
